note: ROOT FIX: The live Cloudflare Worker snx-cloudstream was running v1.0 (an old build) that returned {"error":"Unauthorized"} for ALL /api/stream/start requests regardless of the Authorization header sent. The current source (v1.5.0) uses Firebase ID token verification via identitytoolkit accounts:lookup, which was never deployed. Fixed by: (1) adding chrislegendofshadows.com to ALLOWED_ORIGINS in cloudstream-worker.js, (2) deploying the current v1.5.0 worker (version ID 40b6c48a). CORS preflight now returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://chrislegendofshadows.com. Unauthenticated POST returns 401 with descriptive message. Authenticated POST with valid Firebase ID token from project horr-a08f4 will be accepted and broadcast will start.
